code: set.seed(1) example_data <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(60), x2 = rnorm(60)) example_data$y <- 1 + 2 * example_data$x1 + rnorm(60, sd = 0.4) selection <- select_nnet(   y ~ x1 + x2,   data = example_data,   max_size = 1,   n_starts = 2,   maxit = 500,   seed = 2,   progress = FALSE )  selection #> statnnet model selection #> Call: #> select_nnet(x = y ~ x1 + x2, data = example_data, max_size = 1,  #>     n_starts = 2, maxit = 500, seed = 2, progress = FALSE) #> Selected model: 1 input column, 1 hidden unit, 4 network weights #> BIC: 81.590; 5 candidate models; 10 converged starts #> Selected terms: x1 #> Excluded terms: x2 summary(selection) #> statnnet model-selection summary #> Selected formula: y ~ x1 #> Architecture: 1-1-1; 4 weights #> BIC: 81.590 #> Search: 5 candidates; 0 failed candidates; 0 failed starts #>  #> Terms #>  term selected #>    x1     TRUE #>    x2    FALSE coef(selection) #>       b->h1      i1->h1        b->o       h1->o  #>  -0.6055015  -0.2181255  15.3085551 -40.4499540  head(predict(selection)) #>         [,1] #> 1 -0.2601090 #> 2  1.3941326 #> 3 -0.6992796 #> 4  4.0559063 #> 5  1.6830968 #> 6 -0.6673043 plot(selection)

title: Augment a fitted nnet model with statistical summaries — statnnet
code: data("auto_mpg", package = "statnnet") example_data <- auto_mpg example_data$mpg <- as.numeric(scale(example_data$mpg)) example_data$weight <- as.numeric(scale(example_data$weight)) set.seed(3) fit <- nnet::nnet(   mpg ~ weight + origin,   data = example_data,   size = 1,   linout = TRUE,   decay = 0.1,   Hess = TRUE,   maxit = 500,   trace = FALSE ) model <- statnnet(fit, data = example_data, response = "continuous") model #> statnnet: statistical summary of a fitted nnet model #> Formula: mpg ~ weight + origin #> Architecture: 3-1-1; 6 weights; n = 392 #> Response: continuous; decay: 0.1 #> nnet convergence code: 0 #> Covariance: available (reciprocal condition number 0.000415)

title: statnnet 0.1.0
text: Added select_nnet() information-criterion selection input terms hidden-layer size using multiple nnet initialisations. Added statnnet_selection objects print, summary, coefficient, prediction, plot, selection_path() methods. statnnet() now accepts model-selection result records subsequent uncertainty summaries conditional selected model. Added plot_network() visualising fitted network weights inferential annotations. statnnet() now retains validates existing fitted nnet object. Added explicit objective, Hessian, covariance, convergence, conditioning diagnostics. Added inferential-scope diagnostics: statnnet() now warns hidden nodes outnumber fitted input nodes flags binary-response calibration unvalidated rather equating numerical invertibility calibration. Added structured grouped Wald summaries partial covariate effects. Replaced legacy Boston data examples openly licensed Auto MPG data, including reproducible data-preparation script provenance.
